parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one. You will hear a woman phoning a domestic cleaning agency to inquire about arranging cleaning services for her home.

First, you have some time to look at questions one to four.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to four.

Good morning, Home Care Cleaning Agency.

Oh, hello. I'd like to arrange to have some cleaning done, please.

Certainly. Have you used our services before?

No, I haven't, but a friend of mine has often used your company and suggested I phone you.

Oh, that's great. I'll just take some details from you, and then you can let me know exactly what you would like done.

Okay.

First of all, uh, what area are you in?

I'm in the southwest.

Okay. And are you interested in having a regular cleaner, or is this a one-off clean?

No, I'd like to arrange to have someone come in once a week.

Right. Now, let's just get a bit of information about the house. How many bedrooms does it have?

Three.

Are they all double bedrooms?

Well,

one of the bedrooms is quite small, so it's probably really two double rooms.

Right.

We have the small bedroom set up as an office.

Okay. And just a standard kitchen, lounge, dining room, and bathroom?

Well, actually, we don't have a separate dining room. It's a kitchen diner. Then there's the lounge, and as well as that, we have a family room. Oh, and two bathrooms.

Okay.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions five to ten.

Now listen and answer questions five to ten.

Right. That's all I need to know about the house itself. Now, what we do is we offer a basic cleaning service, and then you let us know about anything extra you'd like cleaned.

Right. And, uh, what does the basic service include?

We clean all the floors and surfaces and do a basic clean in the kitchen and bathroom.

Okay, that sounds good. Oh, and do you clean windows?

Well, I'm afraid we don't do that, the health and safety regulations, but we do offer other special services. We can put clean sheets on the beds, for example.

Uh-huh.

Or we can clean out your fridge. A lot of people like that done.

Oh, I'm not so worried about that, but I would like the sheets changed.

That's no problem. We can do that.

What about the carpet?

As well as the standard vacuum, we can shampoo it if you want.

Right. We've got young children, so it gets pretty dirty. I haven't had it done for six months. It really needs doing more often than that.

You can have it done every month if you like, but three months is what we usually recommend.

That sounds good.

The only other thing is the washing. Do you do laundry work?

Yes, we do. That's no problem. What exactly would you like done?

Well, it's no problem to put a load of washing in the machine. I can do that, but I would like to have the ironing done.

That's fine. And would you like the washing put away in drawers or wardrobes?

No, it's okay. You can just leave everything out and fold it up.

Okay. Right. Now, I'll just set up an account for you, and I'll take down some of your details. Uh, first of all, what's your full name?

It's Rose Kelly.

And could I have your home address, please, Mrs. Kelly?

Yes, it's Forty-eight Amyes Road. That's [chuckles]

A-M-Y-E-S, and that's in Mount Eden.

Okay. Now, what day of the week would you like the property cleaned?

It doesn't really matter. Not Monday, but any other day.

Okay. Let's see. We have a cleaner in your area later on Thursday, so shall we go for that day? We could have someone there by about nine-thirty in the morning. Does that suit you?

Yes, that's fine. And do you charge an hourly rate or a total for the whole job?

No, we charge by the hour. It will work out to about twenty-five dollars per hour.

Oh, that's quite reasonable. I thought it might be closer to thirty dollars.

And how long do you expect it to take?

Well, you said the house isn't large, so I'd guess no more than three hours at the most. We can occasionally finish a three-bedroom in two and a half, but that's probably not too realistic.

Right. That sounds good.

Okay. That's lovely. Uh, thank you very much, and we'll have someone there next week.

Thank you.

That is the end of part one. You now have forty-five seconds to check your answers to part one.

analyses.content: 接待员问在什么区域（what area），顾客直接回答在southwest。
First of all, uh, what area are you in? I'm in the southwest.
这是一道直接给答案的送分题，顺着问答逻辑直接捕捉方向词即可。
How many bedrooms does it have? Three. Are they all double bedrooms? Well, one of the bedrooms is quite small, so it's probably really two double rooms.
你可能一开始听到了“Three”，但题目已经给出了数量词“two”，所以要往后听顾客具体是怎么分类的，不要盲目填自己听到的第一个数字。
接待员问是不是所有的卧室都是double bedrooms，顾客说有一个很小，所以实际上只有两个（two）double rooms。
We have the small bedroom set up as an office.
你可能会死等题干里的“used as”这个短语，但录音里替换成了“set up as”，要注意去听这间小房子到底被当做了什么用途。
紧接着上一题，顾客明确说明那个小卧室被布置成了（set up as）一个office。
Well, actually, we don't have a separate dining room. It's a kitchen diner. Then there's the lounge, and as well as that, we have a family room.
接待员在一开始猜了一大串房间名字，你要稳住不要急着写，等顾客自己逐一纠正和确认的才是最终答案。
顾客在逐一纠正和确认房间列表时，说完厨房餐厅（kitchen diner）后，紧接着就提到了lounge（客厅）。

Complete the notes below.
Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer.

questions.question: Which extra service does agency agree to provide?

analyses.content: Well, I'm afraid we don't do that, the health and safety regulations. But we do offer other special services. We can put clean sheets on the beds, for example. Uh-huh. Or we can clean out your fridge. A lot of people like that done. I'm not so worried about that, but I would like the sheets changed. That's no problem. We can do that.
录音里把A、B、C三个选项全提了一遍，你要听准顾客拒绝了清冰箱（C），擦玻璃（B）被机构拒绝，只有换床单（A）是双方同意的。
顾客明确表示希望换床单（would like the sheets changed），接待员也答应了，这里的sheets对应选项A的bed linen。

questions.question: What will be cleaned more thoroughly every three months?

analyses.content: 顾客问到地毯（carpet）怎么处理，接待员建议每三个月（three months）彻底用洗发水清洗一次。

What about the carpet? As well as the standard vacuum, we can shampoo it if you want. Right. We've got young children, so it gets pretty dirty. I haven't had it done for six months. It really needs doing more often than that. You can have it done every month if you like, but three months is what we usually recommend.
你听到顾客提到了“小孩子（young children）”可能会脑补选A儿童房，但这里提到孩子只是为了说明地毯变脏的原因，核心讨论物品依然是地毯。

analyses.content: Well, it's no problem to put a load of washing in the machine. I can do that, but I would like to have the ironing done. That's fine. And would you like the washing put away in drawers or wardrobes? No, it's okay. You can just leave everything out and fold it up.
选项A（洗衣服）和C（把衣服收进衣柜）顾客都明确表示自己能搞定或不需要，你要重点听转折词“but”后面跟的真正诉求。
顾客明确表示自己可以洗衣服，但是转折后说明希望保洁员来帮忙熨衣服（have the ironing done）。

analyses.content: Yes. It's Forty-eight Amyes Road. That's [laughs] A-M-Y-E-S, and that's in Mount Eden.
这就是一道纯考拼写基本功的题，注意力集中，听到什么字母就老老实实写下来，千万不要把E和A这种常见字母听混了。
顾客在报出家庭地址后，非常贴心地把街道名字母逐个拼写了出来（A-M-Y-E-S）。

It doesn't really matter. Not Monday, but any other day. Okay. Let's see. We have a cleaner in your area later on Thursday, so shall we go for that day? We could have someone there by about nine-thirty in the morning. Does that suit you? Yes, that's fine.
你听到顾客提到了周一（Monday）可能就急着写，但前面加了否定词“Not”，你要听双方商量后最终敲定的日子。
顾客说除了周一哪天都行，随后接待员提议安排在周四（Thursday），顾客最后表示同意（Yes, that's fine）。

And how long do you expect it to take? Well, you said the house isn't large, so I'd guess no more than three hours at the most. We can occasionally finish a three-bedroom in two and a half, but that's probably not too realistic. Right. That sounds good.
录音后面又抛出了一个干扰信息“两个半小时（two and a half）”，但紧接着说那“不太现实（not too realistic）”，所以要坚守前面那个非常肯定的三小时。
题目问的是最长工作时间（Maximum length），接待员明确说最多不超过三小时（no more than three hours at the most）。
